composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwner
  next: normalizeAddress

normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: ensureUniqueTelephone

ensureUniqueTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerTelephone
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueHousehold

ensureUniqueHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipNumber

assignMembershipNumber:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipNumber
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

content.text:
VERDICT: LGTM

The change is a faithful, additive copy of the patterns already established in this package:

- **`EnsureCityCapacity`** sits alongside `EnsureUniqueOwnerTelephone` and `EnsureUniqueOwnerHousehold` as a pre-`build` guard step, uses the same `@Val OwnerFieldsDto request` + `OwnerRepository` signature, and throws a checked exception — exactly the sibling idiom. Its `findAll()`-loop with `equalsIgnoreCase` counting mirrors `AssignCustomerCode` and `AssignNamesakeCount` (the per-city / per-namesake counting convention this codebase already uses), so it does not introduce a novel or misplaced idiom. The magic number is named (`CITY_CAPACITY`) and the javadoc explains the pre-save timing, matching the neighbors.
- **`CityAtCapacityException`** is a structural twin of `DuplicateHouseholdException` / `DuplicateTelephoneException` (checked, message built in constructor, typed getters, javadoc pointing to its handler).
- **`CityAtCapacityExceptionHandler`** matches `DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler` / `DuplicateTelephoneExceptionHandler` line-for-line, reusing the shared `ProblemDetails.build(...)` helper and the `field` / `rejectedValue` property convention (409, field `city`).
- The escalation YAML and the POST pipeline wiring (`govern: [ transaction ]`, inserted before `build`) follow the AGENTS.md conventions and existing file.

Logic is in the right unit (one concern per class), nothing is duplicated beyond the per-city counting loop that the codebase has already standardized on, and no class is becoming a catch-all. A maintainer here would find it entirely natural.
